title: TEST ONLY — Signal Garden
profile: Premature implementer; writes working SQL quickly but trusts attractive graphs.
goal: Interpret a simulated environmental sensor pipeline with provenance and uncertainty.

sessions.title: A clean average hides bad units
sessions.learner_prediction: A script with no exception gives a valid temperature mean.
sessions.learner_attempt: Average mixed sensor values using Python.
sessions.observation: One source emits Fahrenheit while the other emits Celsius.
sessions.correction: Correct execution does not establish comparable measurements.

decision.choice: Normalise declared units and retain raw values
decision.reason: A provenance-preserving transform can be inspected and corrected.

sessions.unresolved: Undeclared units must be rejected or investigated, not guessed.
sessions.next_action: Compute the converted example and compare with the raw mean.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: Missing intervals become zeros
sessions.learner_prediction: The plant must have briefly frozen.
sessions.learner_attempt: Fill missing readings with zero before plotting.
sessions.observation: The source has no reading at that time; zero was introduced by the pipeline.
sessions.correction: An inserted zero is not an observed environmental measurement.

decision.reason: A gap should remain distinguishable from a measured zero.

sessions.unresolved: Interpolation is a modelling choice requiring a reason.
sessions.next_action: Plot or tabulate a null gap and an actual zero side by side.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: Offsets defeat text sorting
sessions.learner_attempt: Insert ISO timestamp strings into SQL and ORDER BY the raw text.
sessions.observation: Mixed offsets produce an order different from absolute UTC time.
sessions.correction: Normalise comparable aware instants while preserving the original timestamp.

decision.choice: Store UTC plus source timestamp and sensor ID
decision.reason: The model should support both analysis and audit.

sessions.next_action: Use the shared time-normalisation helper and test a mixed-offset pair.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.

sessions.title: The misleading aggregate
sessions.learner_prediction: The pooled mean describes the whole garden equally.
sessions.learner_attempt: Compare a pooled mean with sensor-specific readings while one sensor reports ten times as often.
sessions.observation: The high-frequency sensor dominates the pooled mean.
sessions.correction: An observation-weighted mean differs from a sensor-weighted comparison.

decision.reason: A useful dashboard explains what population its statistic represents.

sessions.unresolved: A suspected stuck sensor is not automatically faulty; inspect independent evidence first.
sessions.next_action: Calculate both means, inspect counts and choose an aggregation matching the question.
sessions.evidence_boundary: All learner activity is scripted simulation. Artifacts may be executed by the lab runner; that does not prove a human learner executed or understood them.
